intro.title: What is WeGolden?
body: WeGolden is the forex and CFD broker of the WeCopy Fintech group, alongside the copy-trading platform WeCopyTrade and the prop firm WeMasterTrade. Clients trade on MetaTrader 5 with retail and professional account types.
This portal is WeGolden's home in the Middle East and North Africa: guides in English, Arabic and Farsi, current promotions, and everything partners need to grow with us.

guides.leverageLead: Leverage on forex and gold adjusts automatically to your account equity.
leverageNotes: Silver, indices and energies: 1:100. Crypto and shares: 1:10.
Forex and gold drop to 1:30 from 23:00 to 02:00, from weekend close to reopen, and 15 minutes before and after major news.

faq.a: MetaTrader 5. Use the WeGolden-Live server for real accounts and WeGolden-Demo to practise.
Yes. Open a WeGolden-Demo account on MT5 to practise without risk.

faq.q: Can I open a swap-free account?
faq.a: Yes, verified clients can apply. The swap-free period depends on your qualifying deposit — see Promotions.

faq.q: Who do I contact for help?
faq.a: Our regional support team on Telegram or by email, in English, Arabic and Farsi.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.lead: Current programs for WeGolden clients and partners.
promotions.swapLead: Hold positions overnight without swap charges. The bigger your qualifying deposit, the longer it lasts.
swapNotes: MT5 Standard and ECN accounts; full verification required. Each deposit counted toward a tier must be at least $300.
Contact Support within 48 hours of your qualifying deposit to activate. Positions opened before the switch keep standard swaps.
Covers forex, indices, metals and energies. Stock CFDs still carry swaps.
Positions on gold, silver, USDCAD, JPY crosses, WTI, Brent, minor and exotic pairs should not be held longer than 5 days.
promotions.savingsLead: Put an idle balance to work for a fixed term. Minimum participation: $5,000.
promotions.savingsNote: Withdrawing before the end of the term carries a penalty. Full terms are in the client area.
promotions.leagueBody: A four-month competition for IB partners with an $8,100 prize pool. Season dates and rules will be announced on our Telegram channel.
promotions.goldLead: A cash bonus for depositing and trading gold. Enrolment is automatic.
goldPoints: Make a single deposit of $1,000 or more during 2026.
Trade 18 XAUUSD lots (Standard) or 30 lots (ECN) within 30 days.
Receive $300 credited to your balance as real funds — tradable and withdrawable once credited.
Scales with your deposit: $2,000 → 36 lots (Standard) → $600, and so on per $1,000.
Copy trades, hedged positions and very short trades do not count toward the volume.
promotions.bonusLead: Extra margin on your deposit to trade bigger positions.
bonusPoints: Up to 20% on qualifying deposits, capped at $2,000 per client.
MT5 Standard and ECN accounts; full verification required.
Request activation from Support within 48 hours of your deposit.
Bonus funds become withdrawable after meeting the trading requirements in the full terms.
Use the bonus within 3 months of crediting.

partners.rebateLead: Paid automatically on every lot your clients trade, withdrawable daily.
partners.mibLead: Based on your network's monthly net deposit (deposits − withdrawals − MIB commission).
partners.mibNote: Between $5,000 and $19,999: 2% of net deposit. One reward level per calendar month.
partners.condBody: To withdraw IB rewards, refer at least 2 new clients who are fully verified, deposit at least $500 and trade at least 1 standard lot each. Clients transferred from other IBs do not count.
partners.legal: This page summarises the program. The WeGolden IB Agreement and official program terms prevail.
